# Stride Haven Engineering Solutions FZE

> Stride Haven Engineering Solutions FZE is a vendor-neutral instrumentation, analytical, automation, gas detection, IoT and engineering solutions company based in Hamriya Free Zone, Sharjah, United Arab Emirates, serving process industries across the UAE, Middle East and Africa.

Stride Haven engineers, integrates, manufactures and delivers complete solutions across seven categories: instrumentation, analytical, gas and flame detection, automation, IoT and digital, engineering services, and in-house manufacturing. The company is engineering-first and vendor-neutral, specifying and integrating technology from leading global brands (including Yokogawa, ABB, Endress+Hauser, Emerson and Honeywell) based on project fit rather than a fixed catalogue. Clients include major operators and EPC contractors across oil and gas, petrochemical, power, water and wastewater treatment, desalination, utilities, and food and beverage industries.

## Solutions

- [Instrumentation Solutions](https://www.stride-haven.com/instrumentation-solutions.html): Pressure, temperature, flow and level transmitters — selection, installation and calibration support.
- [Analytical Solutions](https://www.stride-haven.com/analytical-solutions.html): pH, ORP, conductivity, turbidity, chlorine, TOC, UV254 and SDI analyzers for water and process quality.
- [Gas & Flame Detection](https://www.stride-haven.com/gas-detection-solutions.html): Fixed and portable gas detectors, flame detectors and confined space monitoring, engineered to ATEX, IECEx and SIL requirements.
- [Automation Solutions](https://www.stride-haven.com/automation-solutions.html): PLC, SCADA and HMI integration, control panels and ESD/SIS interfacing.
- [IIoT & Digital Solutions](https://www.stride-haven.com/iiot-solutions.html): Industrial IoT remote monitoring with gateways, GSM/4G/LoRaWAN connectivity, SCADA/cloud dashboards and alarm notifications.
- [Engineering Services](https://www.stride-haven.com/engineering-services.html): FDS, datasheets, hook-up drawings, GAD, ITP, FAT/SAT and technical compliance documentation for EPC and consultant projects.
- [In-House Manufacturing](https://www.stride-haven.com/manufacturing-solutions.html): Analyzer panels, instrument panels and skid-mounted systems, built in Sharjah, UAE with FAT and inspection support.
